mapper.select: WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(#{YYYYMM},1,4) AS YYYY , #{YYYYMM} AS YYYYMM FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.etxpyaplyandinq.mapper.NgtmWorkEtxpyAplyMapper.selectNgtmWorkEtxpyAplyList2 : 년간 야간근무수당신청 LIST */ AA.GIVE_YM , AA.NIGHT_WORK_HR , AA.PENSN_SUM_AMT , AA.APRV_YN FROM ZZ , AYC350 AA /* 야간근무수당 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.GIVE_YM BETWEEN ZZ.YYYY||'01' AND ZZ.YYYYMM AND AA.CONSTT_ID = #{USER_ID}

WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{YYYYMM} AS YYYYMM FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.etxpyaplyandinq.mapper.NgtmWorkEtxpyAplyMapper.selectNgtmWorkEtxpyAplyList3 : 년간 야간근무수당신청 count */ COUNT(*) CCNT FROM ZZ , AYC350 AA /* 야간근무수당 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.GIVE_YM = ZZ.YYYYMM AND AA.CONSTT_ID = #{USER_ID}
